items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: jumping for Bardot, jumping for Paris, jumping for whatever you are.

ctx.x: I liked the idea of having two tenor players

We did a lot of battling traveling too, and we did -- I did recordings with Eddy, you know, (inaudible) one "Where or When," of the things here with me on (inaudible), but it was a beautiful tour, and we played one head arrangement. That was ("Jumpin' with Symphony Sid" -- ed.) the opening. La-de-doo-day-day-deedle-day-doo-dee, yo-dee, and Milton Buckner would call -- he was the man in charge and the leader of the group, and they was jumping from wherever you were, jumping for Bardot, jumping for Paris, jumping…
